title: Genealogy_Registry_Definitions
description: Administrative envelope properties and container metadata for top-level entity registries and indices.

$schema.description: Relative URI or file path pointing to the governing registry schema.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the registry schema.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the registry container was initialized.

last_modified.description: ISO-8601 timestamp representing the last write/mutation operation on this registry.

total_count.description: Total count of active entities contained in the registry payload array.
